name: Darcy Richardson
title: Registered Psychologist
description: Registered Psychologist who values the power of authenticity, relational healing, and moving towards an integrated self. Works primarily with adults with identity struggles, impacts from trauma (including PTSD, complex PTSD), anxiety, and eating differences/disordered eating. Uses a HAES lens and neurodivergent-affirming framework, and 'prioritises working with our LGBTQIA+SB community (as a proud member herself)'. Skilled at working with disabled communities, Autistic folk and ADHDers. Ground level, wheelchair accessible; video sessions also offered.
specialties: trauma, PTSD, complex PTSD, LGBTQIA+SB, identity, eating disorders, neurodivergent-affirming, disability

name: Regan Sharp
title: Psychologist, Senior Clinician & Clinic Lead
description: On leave returning late 2026. Neurodiversity-affirming and disability-inclusive. Interests: 'LGBTIQA+ mental health with a focus on exploration and affirmation of gender, sex and sexuality. Regan has a special interest in supporting transgender and non-binary folks to thrive'; sexual health, intimacy and sex therapy; experience working with poly, kink and sex worker communities. Trained in DBT, EFT and trauma therapy.
specialties: transgender, non-binary, gender affirmation, sex therapy, sexuality, kink, poly, sex workers, trauma, perinatal, body image

name: Jayson Hurvitz
title: Social Worker (Mental Health Accredited, AASW)
description: Works with adolescents and adults. 'I support people from LGBTIQ+ communities, including transgender and gender diverse clients', plus CALD, immigrants and refugees. People see him for trauma (including family violence and sexual abuse), identity, sexuality and self-esteem, OCD, substance use. Draws on CBT, ACT, solution-focused therapy, schema work and EMDR. Mon, Tue, Thu.
specialties: transgender, gender diverse, LGBTIQ+, trauma, sexual abuse, EMDR, schema, sexuality

name: Darryl Ribaux
title: Clinical Psychologist

specialties: schema therapy, same-sex attracted, LGBTQIA+, CBT
